package teacherdialog_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type dialogNBAReader struct {
	action domain.TeacherNextAction
	err    error
	calls  int
}

func TestWhatShouldIDoNowWithLiveStudentAuthority(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := os.Getenv("NBA_PROOF_STUDENT_ID")
	baseURL := os.Getenv("NBA_LIVE_STUDENT_URL")
	token := os.Getenv("NBA_LIVE_TEACHER_TOKEN")
	if studentID == "" || baseURL == "" || token == "" {
		t.Skip("NBA live owner fixture required")
	}
	client := liveOwnerReader{baseURL: baseURL, token: token}
	owner, err := client.GetNextAction(context.Background(), studentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, souls := validWorkerFixture(t)
	jobs.job.Request.StudentID = studentID
	jobs.job.Request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextGeneral
	jobs.job.Request.ContextID = ""
	jobs.job.Request.LearningActionID = ""
	teacher := validTeacher()
	teacher.StudentID = studentID
	worker.Teachers = teacherReader{teacher: teacher}
	souls.soul.StudentID = studentID
	dialog.context.StudentID = studentID
	dialog.context.ContextType = domain.LearningContextGeneral
	dialog.context.ContextID = ""
	dialog.context.LearningActionID = ""
	source := &dialog.context.Messages[len(dialog.context.Messages)-1]
	source.Body = "What should I do now?"
	source.LearningActionID = ""
	worker.NextActions = client
	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
	require.Zero(t, builder.calls)
	require.Equal(t, owner.ReasonCode, jobs.savedDecision.ReasonCode)
	require.NotEmpty(t, jobs.completedMessage)
	require.NotEmpty(t, jobs.savedBody)
	require.Contains(t, jobs.savedDecision.ReasonSummary, owner.SourceVersions.StateDigest)
}

func (r *dialogNBAReader) GetNextAction(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error) {
	r.calls++
	return r.action, r.err
}
func TestWhatShouldIDoNowUsesStudentWithoutModel(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	jobs.job.Request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextGeneral
	jobs.job.Request.ContextID = ""
	jobs.job.Request.LearningActionID = ""
	dialog.context.ContextType = domain.LearningContextGeneral
	dialog.context.ContextID = ""
	dialog.context.LearningActionID = ""
	source := &dialog.context.Messages[len(dialog.context.Messages)-1]
	source.Body = "What should I do now?"
	source.LearningActionID = ""
	owner := &dialogNBAReader{action: domain.TeacherNextAction{Schema: domain.TeacherNextActionSchemaVersion, PolicyVersion: domain.TeacherNextActionPolicyVersion, Status: "WAITING", SecondaryActions: []domain.NextActionChoice{}, ReasonCode: "validation_running", SourceVersions: domain.TeacherNextActionSourceVersions{StateDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"}}}
	worker.NextActions = owner
	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, owner.calls)
	require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
	require.Zero(t, builder.calls)
	require.Equal(t, "validation_running", jobs.savedDecision.ReasonCode)
	require.NotEmpty(t, jobs.completedMessage)
	require.Contains(t, jobs.savedBody, "провер")
}

// A test-only HTTP bridge exercises the use-case port against the live owner.
// Production-client decoding is separately proven by the transport live test.
type liveOwnerReader struct{ baseURL, token string }

func (r liveOwnerReader) GetNextAction(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, r.baseURL+"/internal/students/"+studentID+"/next-action", nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", r.token)
	res, err := (&http.Client{Timeout: 2 * time.Second}).Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = res.Body.Close() }()
	if res.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.TeacherNextAction{}, fmt.Errorf("owner response %d", res.StatusCode)
	}
	var action domain.TeacherNextAction
	err = json.NewDecoder(res.Body).Decode(&action)
	return action, err
}
